CreateSurfaceProfileComparisonV1.description: Explicitly request the same saved-line profile from two ordered epochs.
CreateSurfaceProfileComparisonV1.title: CreateSurfaceProfileComparisonV1

CreateSurfaceProfileJobV1.description:
Public request: a saved line revision on one exact asset.  The line is *not* in the body —
Core reads it from the saved revision, so a request cannot read a line nobody saved.
CreateSurfaceProfileJobV1.title: CreateSurfaceProfileJobV1

CreateSurfaceProfileV1.description:
One read of one exact asset along one line.  Choosing a line or a date sends nothing;
this request is the explicit act that asks for the read.
CreateSurfaceProfileV1.title: CreateSurfaceProfileV1

ExecutionLocus.description: 처리 실행 위치 (ADR-KSI-010 운영 표면의 판정 대상 — INV-050이 이 값을 강제 조건으로 쓴다).
ExecutionLocus.title: ExecutionLocus

MeasurementFeatureRefV1.description: Exact revision a request or result is bound to.
MeasurementFeatureRefV1.title: MeasurementFeatureRefV1

MeasurementLineV1.description: Vertices in the stated CRS: x,y in metres for a projected CRS, lon,lat for EPSG:4326.
MeasurementLineV1.title: MeasurementLineV1

NodataRepresentation.description: JSON-safe parser observation; NAN is a token, never a non-finite JSON value.
NodataRepresentation.title: NodataRepresentation

ObservedVerticalReferenceV1.description: Parser-observed vertical identifier/basis, distinct from a user declaration.
ObservedVerticalReferenceV1.title: ObservedVerticalReferenceV1

RasterMeasurementsV1.description: Worker-observed raster facts, never a compatibility or accuracy assertion.
RasterMeasurementsV1.title: RasterMeasurementsV1

ResourceEnvelopeV1.description: Configured finite worker limits; values are policy data, never client input.
ResourceEnvelopeV1.title: ResourceEnvelopeV1

SealedExternalSubjectV1.description: Exact external revision identity; Core later proves it is in caller scope.
SealedExternalSubjectV1.title: SealedExternalSubjectV1

SpatialDataRequiredHeaderV1.description: Allowlisted storage headers, never forwarding parent bearer/cookies/Host.
SpatialDataRequiredHeaderV1.title: SpatialDataRequiredHeaderV1

SpatialDataSourceV1.description: Binding shape only: Core must authenticate the actual sealed inspection.
SpatialDataSourceV1.title: SpatialDataSourceV1

SurfaceProfileActivationV1.description: Operator-provisioned authority for one worker instance to run profile jobs.
SurfaceProfileActivationV1.title: SurfaceProfileActivationV1

SurfaceProfileComparisonResultV1.description: Numeric output bound to both exact immutable single-surface results.
SurfaceProfileComparisonResultV1.title: SurfaceProfileComparisonResultV1

SurfaceProfileDeclaredVerticalV1.description:
The user's vertical-reference claim a job was frozen on.  Never an observation.

Frozen with its record digest so the job proves exactly which claim licensed the read; a
corrected or withdrawn declaration is a different record and no longer licenses it.
SurfaceProfileDeclaredVerticalV1.title: SurfaceProfileDeclaredVerticalV1

SurfaceProfileJobViewV1.description:
Requester-visible state.  Carries the receipt, never the numeric samples — those need a
fresh READ proof through the result route.
SurfaceProfileJobViewV1.title: SurfaceProfileJobViewV1

SurfaceProfilePolicyV1.description: Finite limits Core freezes into a job.  Never client input, never defaulted.
SurfaceProfilePolicyV1.title: SurfaceProfilePolicyV1

SurfaceProfileReadWindowV1.description: The one native pixel window a worker may read: sample neighbours only, never the raster.
SurfaceProfileReadWindowV1.title: SurfaceProfileReadWindowV1

SurfaceProfileReceiptV1.description:
What the worker attests it did.  Core verifies it against the frozen job; it never replaces
that check, and it asserts no accuracy.
SurfaceProfileReceiptV1.title: SurfaceProfileReceiptV1

SurfaceProfileResultViewV1.description: The numbers, released only after current READ authority was proven again.
SurfaceProfileResultViewV1.title: SurfaceProfileResultViewV1

SurfaceProfileRuntimeV1.description: The exact build that is allowed to compute profiles.
SurfaceProfileRuntimeV1.title: SurfaceProfileRuntimeV1

SurfaceProfileVerticalReferenceV1.description:
Where the heights' vertical reference comes from: the file (observed) or a user (declared).

Exactly one of the two facts is present.  A declared basis is carried here, next to the
numbers, so no screen or export can present it as something the parser observed.
SurfaceProfileVerticalReferenceV1.title: SurfaceProfileVerticalReferenceV1

SurfaceProfileWorkerInputV1.description: 일꾼이 받는 입력: 봉인된 작업, 현재 attempt, 활성화와 짧은 수명의 원본 읽기 capability.
SurfaceProfileWorkerInputV1.title: SurfaceProfileWorkerInputV1

VerticalDatum.description:
산출물이 어느 수직기준인지 — wire 계약에 실리는 값.

``ELLIPSOIDAL_NATIVE`` 는 "재구성 엔진이 낸 타원체고를 변환 없이 그대로
쓴다"는 뜻이다. ``ELLIPSOIDAL`` 과 굳이 나눈 이유는, 전자가 **의도적으로
선택한 기준**이 아니라 **변환을 하지 못해 남은 상태**임을 소비자가 구분할
수 있어야 하기 때문이다 — 나중에 격자가 확보되면 이 값이 남아 있는
산출물이 곧 재처리 대상 목록이 된다.

두 값의 이 차이는 **호환성 판정에는 영향이 없다** — 둘 다 타원체 기준의
높이라 서로 빼도 되는 값이다(:func:`family_of`). 재처리 대상 표시와
비교 가능성은 다른 축이다.

**정표고 멤버가 지오이드 모델 이름을 달고 있는 이유.** 정표고가 서 있는
기준면은 하나다(KVD1964 = 인천 평균해면, EPSG:5193). 그런데 그 높이를
타원체고와 잇는 지오이드고 N 은 **격자 모델이 준다** — 즉 모델 이름은
"이 높이가 어느 격자로 되돌려지는가"다. 모델이 다르면 국내 지점 대조에서
수 cm 가 어긋나고(KNGeoid18↔24 실측 비교 0.001~0.071m), 그 크기는 체적
집계 문턱(``DEFAULT_VOLUME_THRESHOLD_M`` = 0.05m)과 같은 자릿수다. 그래서
모델을 이름에 박아 두고, **우리가 실제로 격자를 가진 모델만** 타원체고와
잇는다(:data:`_GEOID_BRIDGEABLE_ORTHOMETRIC`).
VerticalDatum.title: VerticalDatum
